svg.desc: IDP Iraq Substations Package LOCATION Iraq CLIENT General Electric (GE) / Iraq Ministry of Electricity COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2022 17 million USD each DISCIPLINES Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This completed project in Iraq involved the detailed civil design of four IDP electric substations for General Electric (GE) and the Iraq Ministry of Electricity, with an estimated construction value of 17 million USD each. Services include architecture, structural and civil engineering, MEP, and technical support. BECT's scope included detailed drawings, tender documents and site supervision.
